detail.longDescription: So apparently an old github repository of mine got a press article made about it? I had no idea! https://www. windowslatest.com/2026/09/07/w indows-11-hack-unlocks-animated-profile-pictures-microsoft-has-been-hiding-from-you/ It's for an old # powershell script I made when I was still on # windows to override registry keys to set a gif or a picture with a transparent background as your profile icon in windows. I only noticed because my github feed had many new stars for this old project. I wonder why now is the time it's getting known? I guess the right person has to talk about it for it to get more known. Anyways here is the repo link for those of you who want it! https:// github.com/helloyanis/windows- account-picture-changer # opensource # foss # github
